title: Nitrogen Excess and Crop Susceptibility
title_hi: नाइट्रोजन की अधिकता और फसल संवेदनशीलता
content:
Excessive nitrogen application, particularly urea top-dressing, increases crop susceptibility to multiple fungal diseases including rice blast, sheath blight, and bacterial leaf blight.

Mechanism: High nitrogen promotes lush, succulent tissue with thinner cell walls and higher free amino acid content in leaves, which serves as food for pathogens. It also creates a dense canopy microclimate with higher humidity — ideal for fungal spore germination.

Symptoms of nitrogen excess: Dark green, overly lush foliage. Lodging (plants falling over). Delayed maturity. Increased disease incidence.

Recommendation: Follow the 4R principle — Right source, Right rate, Right time, Right place. For rice, split nitrogen application: 50% at transplanting, 25% at tillering, 25% at panicle initiation. Use Leaf Color Chart (LCC) to determine if additional nitrogen is needed — if LCC value is 4 or above, do NOT apply more nitrogen.
content_hi:
नाइट्रोजन का अधिक प्रयोग, विशेषकर यूरिया की टॉप-ड्रेसिंग, फसल को कई फफूंद जनित रोगों के प्रति संवेदनशील बनाता है।

लक्षण: गहरे हरे, अत्यधिक घने पत्ते। पौधों का गिरना। परिपक्वता में देरी।

सिफारिश: नाइट्रोजन का विभाजित प्रयोग करें। लीफ कलर चार्ट (LCC) का उपयोग करें।
summary: Excess nitrogen makes crops vulnerable to fungal diseases. Use split application and Leaf Color Chart to optimize nitrogen use.
summary_hi: अधिक नाइट्रोजन फसलों को फफूंद रोगों के प्रति संवेदनशील बनाती है। नाइट्रोजन का विभाजित प्रयोग करें।
actions: Stop urea/nitrogen top-dressing immediately if Leaf Color Chart (LCC) reading is 4 or above.
Switch to split nitrogen application: apply in 3 splits (50% basal, 25% at tillering, 25% at panicle initiation).
Use a Leaf Color Chart (available at KVK for ~₹10) before every nitrogen application.
Drain the field for 2-3 days to reduce nitrogen uptake rate.
Apply muriate of potash (MOP) at 40 kg/ha to improve plant resistance.
warnings: Do NOT apply urea within 3 days of rain — most of it will be lost to runoff/volatilization.
Lush dark green leaves are a warning sign, not a good sign. They attract pests and diseases.
